action: Raise shelves / store stock on platforms at least 15-30 cm off the floor
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Estantería Cromada Orange 5 niveles S/249.90; Estantería Metálica K45 Maletek S/589.00
protects_basis: Kreibich et al. 2005 (German floods): contents damage ratio reduced 48% by 'flood adapted use' — proxy for keeping stock out of the water, not a direct test of shelving
recommendation_quote: 3) Eleva tu mercadería al menos en 15 cm desde el suelo.

name_es: Sacos de arena en la puerta
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24 unit prices: polypropylene sack S/0.80 + 40 kg coarse sand S/6.90 = S/7.70 per filled sack; the 10-30 sack quantity is an illustrative assumption
protects_basis: Kreibich 2005: building damage ratio reduced 29% where water barriers were available; same study found no significant effect on contents in the extreme 2002 flood
recommendation_quote: Si vives cerca de algún cauce, coloca sacos de tierra o arena como protección de tu casa.

action: Sealed / waterproof containers for goods and documents
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Polinplast Megacaja Rock #90 S/64.90; Megarock #200 S/149.90 (hermetic bags: S/7.90 per box of 20)
recommendation_quote: In case of emergency, keep documents in a waterproof container.

action: Flood barrier at the door (compuerta / sealed door base)
name_es: Barrera contra el agua en la puerta
cost_basis: Only S/ figure found: Trujillo municipal 'PCI Barrera' for quebradas, S/500 each (El Búho, Nov 2023) — a loose proxy, not a shop-door product; no Peruvian retail listing found
protects_basis: Kreibich 2005 water barriers: building damage -29% (60-80% if not overtopped, per ICPR 2002); FEMA: only for short floods under ~3 ft
recommendation_quote: Revisa que la parte baja de la puerta de tu casa o negocio cuente con un sistema de protección para que el agua no se filtre.

action: Move high-value stock to an upper floor or safe space
name_es: Subir la mercadería a un lugar seguro
name_en: Move stock to a safe, higher place
cost_basis: S/0 cash if done by the owner; no sourced price for hired help
protects_basis: Kreibich 2005: contents damage ratio -48% for 'flood adapted use' (endangered storeys not used cost-intensively)

cost_basis: APEC SME continuity guide: reserve equal to one month of profit — shop-specific, so no S/ figure
recommendation_quote: NOTA: es recomendable que las compañías guarden una reserva equivalente a un mes de utilidad.

action: Back up business records (cloud copy, photos of inventory, sealed paper copies)
name_es: Copia de seguridad de tus registros
cost_basis: Google One 100 GB S/64.99/year (La República, Dec 2023 — may be outdated); Promart 2026-10-24 Toshiba 1TB external disk S/415
recommendation_quote: Backing up hard copy vital records can be accomplished by scanning paper records into digital formats and allowing them to be backed up along with other digital data.

action: Stock up on non-perishable basics from suppliers before roads are cut
cost_basis: No sourced figure; depends on the shop's inventory. Source advises buying perishables in smaller quantities
recommendation_quote: Una de las principales recomendaciones es abastecerse de productos antes de que las vías o rutas de distribución queden afectadas.

action: Mosquito control for dengue (remove standing water, cover containers, screens, repellent)
name_es: Control de zancudos contra el dengue
cost_unit: 1 window screen up to 2 window screens + 1 door screen + 1 repellent
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: window screen S/5.90, door screen S/10.90, Off aerosol 170 ml S/28.20; quantities illustrative; removing standing water costs nothing
protects_basis: Bowman et al. 2016 meta-analysis: house screening odds ratio 0.22 (95% CI 0.05-0.93) => 1-0.22; an odds reduction, not a risk reduction; repellents showed no significant effect
recommendation_quote: colocar larvicida en polvo dentro de los depósitos donde se almacena agua y utilizar mallas para las ventanas y puertas.

action: Business insurance covering rain and flood (multirriesgo / microseguro)
cost_basis: Confianza/Mapfre microcredit multirriesgo minimum premium S/3.00/month (=S/36/yr); Mapfre Multirriesgo Empresas 24 Horas S/1,944.00/yr incl. IGV for S/30,000 sum insured
protects_basis: Derived from Mapfre deductible '5% del Monto del Siniestro, mínimo S/500': reimburses ~95% of a covered loss up to the sum insured; transfers rather than prevents loss
recommendation_quote: 5) Verifica que tus seguros estén vigentes, sin pagos pendientes y con tu información de contacto actualizada.

action: Clean gutters and drains; repair and waterproof the roof
name_es: Limpiar canaletas y reparar el techo
name_en: Clean gutters and fix the roof
cost_unit: one gutter up to gutter + waterproofing + one roof sheet
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Nicoll 4in gutter 4 m S/69.90; Sikafill Techo-3 4L S/96.50; Precor TR4 aluzinc sheet S/52.90; quantities illustrative; labour not included
recommendation_quote: Protege y refuerza el techo de tu vivienda, revisa el tejado, la bajada de agua y elimina toda acumulación de residuos y materiales que puedan obstaculizar el paso del agua por el drenaje.

action: Electrical safety: 30 mA residual-current breaker, raise outlets, cut power before water enters
cost_unit: breaker (+ outlet); electrician labour not included
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Steck 2x25A 30mA residual-current breaker S/49.90; Sica 2x25 S/157.90 + double outlet S/4.50
protects_basis: Kreibich 2005: utilities installed in higher storeys reduced building damage ratio by 36%
recommendation_quote: El MINEM también recomienda evitar tomacorrientes e interruptores ubicados a nivel del suelo en zonas susceptibles de inundación.

action: Business continuity plan and emergency backpack (mochila de emergencia)
cost_unit: per emergency backpack; plan itself is free (APEC template)
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Mochila de emergencia básica GRM S/99.90; Equipada Mediana S/159.90
protects_basis: No loss-reduction study found; placeholder. Context only: FEMA says 75% of businesses without continuity planning fail within 3 years of a disaster (US)
recommendation_quote: Ten a la mano una Mochila para Emergencias que contenga agua, alimentos no perecibles, abrigo, linterna, radio a pilas y un Botiquín de Primeros Auxilios.

action: Alternative sales channel (WhatsApp orders, delivery, Yape payments)
cost_unit: Yape free up to 5 UIT (S/25,750) of sales a month; Yape Empresa 2.95% of daily sales above that
protects_basis: No loss-reduction study found; placeholder The recommendation source describes the COVID-19 pandemic, not floods.
recommendation_quote: hay cerca de 4,000 que se han iniciado en las ventas vía Whatsapp, para coordinar los pedidos de los clientes y entregarlos por delivery

action: Power-outage and cold-chain plan (don't overload freezers, keep non-perishables, rechargeable lights)
cost_basis: Promart 2026-10-24: Werken 4 LED rechargeable lantern S/14.90; Werken 150 lm headlamp S/29.90
recommendation_quote: recomienda evitar la sobrecarga de las congeladoras y mantener productos no perecibles como respaldo
